name: John Alastair
biography: John trained at the Webber Douglas Academy of Dramatic Art in London after almost 12 years working as a Professional Firefighter. He has been filming 'The Devil's Hour' by Tom Moran for Amazon Prime (Sue Vertue/Steven Moffat - Hartswood Films) appearing in 4 Episodes. He has recently finished filming small parts in Michael Winterbottom's new Drama about the pandemic 'This Sceptred Isle' and 'Ridley Road' directed by Lisa Mulcahy for the BBC.
